floor_history.headline: Confirmed floor 4 (vu32 single-store); killed instance hypothesis that a minimal single-statement body reaches $t9; grant's fold claim only wrong for the volatile reading; sibling has independent hand

Resolved s1 frontier item 1: $t9 IS reachable by genuine register pressure (N>=22 live scratch pseudos, no REG_ALLOC_ORDER override for MIPS), but only at the cost of a 110-insn body with $s0-$s7 save

Two decomp-permuter campaigns (85,461 total iterations, 2 byte-equivalent chassis) found zero novel forms; the $t9 seat and trailing-nop hunks remain unreached by unguided mutation, confirming s1/s2's

Enumerate modality: 16-spelling systematic sweep of the single-store body (decl order/inline, address/value/cast forms, volatile spelling, trailing return) all score 4/5-insns identically -- zero-hit,

frontier.hypothesis: Trailing double-nop after jr $ra is source-level, unexplained by any lever tried so far (recon, structural, unguided permuter search across two chassis, and now an exhaustive spelling sweep all fail to reach it).
frontier.mechanism: unknown; not inter-object padding, not GTE/cop2 latency, not reachable by any spelling of this chassis or single-step AST mutation from either byte-equivalent chassis
frontier.next_probe: Grep other matched leaf functions in this codebase for a jr $ra; nop; nop (double-nop) 6+-insn shape and read their matched C to see what source construct, if any, produces a second nop after the return in a leaf void function -- a targeted grep/read task, not something either the permuter's mutation set or this session's spelling enumeration (both exhausted on the current one-statement chassis) can express.

frontier.hypothesis: A differently-shaped pressure chassis (e.g. 22+ live call-clobbered temporaries with no $s0-$s7 involvement) might reach $t9 without the save/restore overhead s2's chassis incurred.
frontier.mechanism: global.c allocation order is fixed (ascending, no REG_ALLOC_ORDER), but which hard regs get claimed depends on which pseudos conflict; s2 only tried one liveness-shaping idiom and this session's spelling sweep stayed within the single-statement chassis's declaration/order/value variants, none of which change live-range count or shape.
frontier.next_probe: Hand-write (not permute/enumerate) a chassis using genuinely call-clobbered-only values with no calls, forcing the compiler toward $t0-$t9 before $s0-$s7 if any such ordering exists; needs tools/sweep_variants.py over hand-written variants of a structurally different (not just differently-spelled) chassis.

frontier.hypothesis: Re-weigh the canonical-asm grant -- two permuter campaigns (85k+ iterations) plus a 16-way exhaustive spelling sweep finding nothing is additional evidence against a small natural-C body reaching the target bytes.
frontier.next_probe: If the next session's hand-written alternate-pressure-chassis sweep (frontier item 2) also fails, that is four independent methodologies (hand analysis, two permuter chassis, exhaustive spelling enumeration) agreeing -- stronger basis for a ruling-request, though still not conclusive since frontier item 2's specific shape remains untested.
